claims.claim: September consumer price index rose 3.1 percent year-over-year, above the Bank of Canada 1-to-3 percent target band.
claims.episode_span: The TSX fell below 36,000 after Statistics Canada reported September inflation at 3.1 percent, above the Bank of Canada’s 1-to-3 percent target band.
claims.source_title: Toronto Stock Exchange: S&P/TSX Composite Slides Below 36,000 as Canadian Inflation Hits 3.1%
claims.supporting_quote: Statistics Canada reported on Monday that the annual consumer price index rose 3.1% in September, up from 3.0% in August, taking headline inflation above the top of the Bank of Canada's 1% to 3% control range.

claims.claim: BlackRock Canada announced October 2026 cash distributions for iShares ETFs listed on the TSX or Cboe Canada.
claims.episode_span: BlackRock Canada’s October distributions for iShares ETFs show how monthly payers can complement this income overlay.
claims.source_title: BlackRock® Canada Announces October Cash Distributions for the iShares® ETFs
claims.supporting_quote: BlackRock Asset Management Canada Limited (“BlackRock Canada”), an indirect, wholly-owned subsidiary of BlackRock, Inc. (NYSE: BLK), today announced the October 2026 cash distributions for the iShares ETFs listed on the TSX or Cboe Canada which pay on a monthly basis.
